title: Farm Animal Sounds
yt_description:
In this fun song, your child will learn about different animal sounds on the farm. They will discover the sounds of cows, pigs, and chickens. This catchy tune will help your little one develop their auditory skills and learn about farm animals.

🎵 Farm Animal Sounds

Hello friends
Let's go farm
See the cows

Cows go moo
Pigs go oink
Chickens go

Farm animals
Make sounds fun
Moo and oink

Farm animals
Make sounds fun
Moo and oink

Bye friends now
Farm fun ends
See you soon
